correctness.rationale: Fresh independent decoding of the seven hexadecimal generator rows and enumeration of all 128 codewords reproduced the complete weight enumerator: weights 25 through 36 occur with multiplicities 20,34,29,17,7,1,1,6,1,1,6,4 respectively, plus the zero word. Independent enumeration of every subspace of F2 dimension seven gave subspace counts 1,127,2667,11811,11811,2667,127 and maximum contained-column counts 0,2,4,6,10,17,30, hence generalized Hamming weights (25,38,45,49,51,53,55).
residual_risks: The result profiles one optimal-code representative, not all inequivalent optimal [55,7,25] LCD codes.

originality.rationale: The complete 18-page Lim-An-Kim paper was read under authorized access after ordinary open full-text routes failed. It prints the exact generator and proves that [55,7,25] is one of the new optimal LCD codes, but its fitness uses only minimum distance and the number of minimum-weight words. The article does not state the complete weight enumerator or generalized Hamming hierarchy. Targeted Resultary and web searches found no prior exact profile.
